snippet.title: Project ZETA | Global Community Test 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
Project ZETA is a Multi-Team Tactical Arena where four squads battle at once to dominate the arena. Team up, outplay rival teams, and fight for control in a fast-paced playtest built around squad strategy, arena chaos, and multiteam mayhem.

The Project ZETA Playtest runs June 25-28.

Regional match windows:
EU: 6PM-9PM CEST
NA: 5PM-8PM PDT
Asia: 8PM–11PM KST

Download on Steam and join the playtest.
